plan.title: feat(flywheel): first-class 'special orders' runs — operator-supplied order book executed with lane semantics
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

references.label: Order Book page mockup (normative for the page)

narratives.Problem: The special-orders pattern (operator hands the flywheel an ordered two-lane campaign) is proven across RUN-56…62 but exists only as prose briefs: lane serialization, prereqs, re-verify, and membership-as-release are all prompt discipline. Nothing mechanical stops a second Lane B dispatch, nothing mechanically ends the run when the book drains, and there is no surface to assemble or watch an order book.
narratives.Proposal: Make the order book a first-class entity: JSON documents in orders/ on overdeck-state behind a two-door module (src/lib/orders resolver + writer), REST routes, pan orders + pan flywheel start --orders + pan flywheel complete CLI verbs, mechanical lane/prereq enforcement at the start-agent dispatch chokepoint, membership-as-released in isAutoPickable, a FlywheelStatus.orders progress block with mechanical drain detection (parked counts as terminal), drain → retro → continuation doctrine, and a dedicated /orders dashboard page as the ONLY write surface with read-only projections on the flywheel page, issues pane, and a promotion entry point on the backlog page. Design decisions D-1…D-8 of the PRD and the operator's 2026-07-17 mockup decisions are binding; see continue.json decisions.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No SQLite read-through cache for orders in v1 (state-branch JSON only; PRD D-1)
- No support for more than one concurrently running book (single active-run gate stays; PRD D-3)
- No write/edit affordances on the flywheel module, issues-pane widget, or kanban/drawer beyond add-to-book; the backlog page asks only the Lane A/B judgment on promotion — it is not a second editor (operator decision 2026-07-17)
- No change to --brief semantics for bookless runs; backlog-mode runs keep today's behavior (PRD D-8)
- No separate drip-orchestrator or second pipeline authority
- No change to the auto_pickup_backlog default; off-book issues stay gated exactly as today
- No retro ceremony when the flywheel recognizes no findings (single no-findings line only; FR-12)
- Sequencer rank is never rendered as a chip on any surface (muted text only; operator decision 2026-07-17)
